findings.body: The test `a_multibyte_title_does_not_panic` asserts `out.len() <= 21`, but `len()` returns byte length. For the test input `"café ".repeat(40).as_str()`, the truncated head at 20 characters includes multibyte `é` and space, resulting in a byte length of ~27 bytes, so the assertion fails. The correct check should use `out.chars().count()` to count characters, matching the function's character-based limit.
findings.title: Use chars().count() instead of len() in multibyte test

value.summary: One test assertion incorrectly checks byte length instead of character count, causing a test failure for multibyte strings.
